# State Institute of Training (SIT)

> Registered Training Organisation (RTO No. 45205, CRICOS 03948A) delivering hands-on vocational training in Building & Construction, Engineering, and Business & Management. Campuses in Melbourne, Pakenham (Victoria) and Brisbane (Queensland), Australia.

Website: https://sit.vic.edu.au
Contact: info@sit.vic.edu.au | Phone: +61 3 8383 4447
Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 am – 5:00 pm (AEST)

## About

State Institute of Training provides nationally recognised VET qualifications for domestic and international students. Training is practical and industry-focused, with workshops and face-to-face delivery.

## Campuses

- Melbourne: Level 5, 255 William Street, Melbourne VIC 3000
- Pakenham: Level 1, 29 James Street, Pakenham VIC 3810
- Brisbane: Level 3, 300 Adelaide Street, Brisbane QLD 4000

## Courses

### Building & Construction

- [CPC31020 Certificate III in Solid Plastering](https://sit.vic.edu.au/building-and-construction/certificate-iii-in-solid-plastering) — CRICOS 119339G · 52 weeks
- [CPC31320 Certificate III in Wall and Floor Tiling](https://sit.vic.edu.au/building-and-construction/certificate-iii-in-wall-and-floor-tiling) — CRICOS 119340C · 52 weeks
- [CPC40120 Certificate IV in Building and Construction](https://sit.vic.edu.au/building-and-construction/certificate-iv-in-building-and-construction) — CRICOS 119342A · 40 weeks
- [CPC50220 Diploma of Building and Construction (Building)](https://sit.vic.edu.au/building-and-construction/diploma-of-building-and-construction-building) — CRICOS 119341B · 52 weeks

### Engineering

- [MEM31925 Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade](https://sit.vic.edu.au/engineering/certificate-iii-in-engineering-fabrication-trade) — CRICOS 119160G · 62 weeks (includes work placement)
- [MEM40119 Certificate IV in Engineering (Pathway Course)](https://sit.vic.edu.au/engineering/certificate-iv-in-engineering-pathway-entry) — CRICOS 108266K · 30 weeks
- [MEM50222 Diploma of Engineering – Technical](https://sit.vic.edu.au/engineering/diploma-of-engineering-technical) — CRICOS 117580C · 52 weeks
- [MEM80125 Graduate Diploma of Engineering](https://sit.vic.edu.au/engineering/graduate-diploma-of-engineering) — CRICOS 119070J · 104 weeks

### Business & Management

- [BSB50820 Diploma of Project Management](https://sit.vic.edu.au/business-and-management/diploma-of-project-management) — CRICOS 107504J · 60 weeks
